sources: sec edgar submissions api, 8-K item 2.02 acceptance times

history.basis: 6-K exhibit text matched results language (9 filings opened). Heuristic, not an item code: a 6-K carrying results language is very likely an earnings release but this is weaker than the 8-K item 2.02 path

event_plausibility.reason: DOWNGRADE, and on 2026-09-04 it is the ONLY amendment -- a pass whose sole entry lowers a verdict, which is worth stating plainly because the symmetry rule is usually invoked the other way round. Waterdrop's 2026-09-08 pre-open date IS confirmed by its own PR Newswire release of 2026-08-25 (call 8:00 a.m. ET), so the event is real. But the 'fits_cadence' verdict is an artefact: it rests on a median gap of 85 days computed over a filing set that contains THREE 6-Ks inside one quarter -- 2026-06-17, 2026-06-23 and 2026-07-24 -- where at most one earnings release can exist. As a foreign private issuer Waterdrop files no item 2.02, and it 6-Ks its buybacks, special dividends and AGM material, all of which carry results-shaped language the text matcher accepts. The verdict also reads 'last print 2026-07-24', 46 days ago, which would make the 2026-09-08 event a second print inside the same quarter. Only the five older entries (2025-03-12, 2025-06-05, 2025-09-04, 2025-12-03, 2026-03-25) form a clean quarterly chain, so the 2.29% median and the 1.5% deadband derived from it rest on eight rows of which at most six are earnings reactions. 'unknown' not 'suspect': the event is established, its history simply does not characterise it.

amended_from.reason: 46 days since the last print against a 85-day cadence

event_plausibility.amended_by: edge sweep, company-sourced; before any hunter launched

deadband_basis: half the median of 8 prior reactions, floored at 1.5%
deadband_note: A realised move inside this band is scored as no-direction rather than as a miss.
expected_move_basis: median historical reaction (no usable option chain)

baseline_quality.note: thin means there is no reliable statement of what the market priced, so a confident call on this name cannot be justified by the baseline.
